Subject: Re: Fwd: API errors and big latency spike — triage + P0 ops

Quick update from infra side:
- We see elevated RTTs and packet retransmits from several TileCo source IP ranges when bogged behind our egress proxy cluster in us-west-2.
- NAT allocation for a subset of pods hit port exhaustion briefly at 07:46 and autoscaled; short window (~3m) of 502s as connections retried.
- Simultaneously, our authoritative edge DNS in us-west-2 experienced a soft degradation with increased retry rate (avg response time 420ms -> 1.2s) correlated to a misrouted healthcheck traffic surge from a partner mesh.
- No recent firewall policy changes in the past 24h.

Immediate mitigations applied: increased NAT port pool and forced proxy cluster roll to flush half the nodes. Also pinned a fallback route to an alternate peering for TileCo.

Next steps: run extended pcap capture, pull DNS query logs for TileCo prefixes, coordinate with TileCo SRE on TTL refresh.

-Vivek
Principal SRE, Infra

Attachments: egress-dns-query-log-20260830.csv

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Julia Hart <julia.hart@tileco.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: API errors and big latency spike — triage + P0 ops

Looping in network team findings and a short remediation plan:
1) Cause analysis (prelim): interaction of partner-mesh healthcheck storms + peering route flap led to asymmetric path for TileCo -> our egress proxies. Asymmetric path amplified retransmits; combined with NAT port exhaustion produced transient 502/504s.
2) Action taken: forced peering reconverge, temporarily shifted TileCo traffic to peering-bypass route (lower throughput but lower RTT), scaled NAT pools, increased DNS authoritative read replicas in us-west-2.
3) Customer-visible: we expect reduced 5xxs within 30m and tokenization latency back to baseline within 60m.

We also recommend offering TileCo a goodwill credit — this is material for their ingestion SLAs. Mina, can you manage the credit request and exec notification?

-Rishi
Director, Network Services
